title.zh: 深色茶几与电视柜组合

summary.en: Compare two low-profile pieces for a coordinated living room.
summary.zh: 用两款低矮家具搭配统一的客厅风格。

description.en:
A dark woodgrain-look coffee table and long TV unit are shown together as a living-room style reference. The stepped coffee-table form and open TV-unit compartments offer different ways to arrange everyday items.
Tell us whether you need one piece or both, then confirm each model’s dimensions and packing.
description.zh:
配图将深色木纹茶几与长电视柜放在一起，便于比较客厅搭配效果。阶梯式茶几外观与电视柜开放格提供不同物品摆放位置。
请说明需要其中一件还是两件，再分别核对尺寸与包装。

en: Coffee-table and TV-unit styles shown together.
One-piece or coordinated-set requirements confirmed separately.
zh: 同时展示茶几与电视柜款式。
单件或组合采购需求分别确认。
